# QuietStaff

> QuietStaff Ltd is a UK company (registered in England and Wales, company no. 17171308) building AI agents for UK agencies and owner-led businesses. Its agents prepare the work and the client's people approve it. Senior consulting and delivery sit behind the product.

Contact: contact@quietstaff.com · Book a call: https://cal.com/quietstaff/intro

## Product

- [Quiet Staff One](https://quietstaff.co.uk/one/): AI agents for enquiries, content, knowledge and connected work, approved by your team. Built and supported with you by QuietStaff.
- [QuietDesk](https://quietstaff.co.uk/quietdesk/): answers enquiries for heating and plumbing firms, offers visit slots you confirm and drafts quotes you approve.
- [QuietStart](https://quietstaff.co.uk/quietstart/): a conversation about one business workflow: what happens today, where it gets stuck and a useful next step.
- [FAQs](https://quietstaff.co.uk/faq/): getting started with Quiet Staff One, pricing, existing tools and human review.

## Consulting and partners

- [Fractional CTO and engineering teams](https://quietstaff.co.uk/consulting/): a senior technical lead for an agreed part of each week, or a dedicated engineering team run end to end.
- [Technical partner for UK agencies](https://quietstaff.co.uk/partners/delivery/): build, integrate, automate, AI and data work for UK agencies and consultancies, under your name if you prefer.
- [OpenAI Select Partner](https://quietstaff.co.uk/partners/openai/): QuietStaff is an OpenAI Select Partner.
